name: Hanover Parks & Recreation Camps
description_short: Town-run day camps for preschoolers (ages 2-4) and children entering kindergarten through grade 5: 6 themed summer weeks at Richmond Middle School, 2 August minicamps, and weeklong camps during the February and April school vacations.
swim_waterfront_notes: Each summer week includes time at Storrs Pond. The Outdoor Adventure minicamp visits Mink Brook every day and includes water activities. The page gives no details on swim instruction, swim tests or lifeguarding.

warnings: This is the Town of Hanover website (Parks & Recreation), not a standalone camp site. The only address shown is Town Hall's, not the camp's.
The page mixes seasons: it mentions 2027 camper contact forms, but the minicamps still say "2026 Dates: TBA" and the schedules are labeled 2026 ("2027 coming soon"). Fees may be 2026 rates.
The February 22-26 and April 19-23 vacation camp dates have no year. They were recorded as 2027 because those dates fall Monday-Friday in 2027 (not in 2026), and today is Oct 2026.
Session prices use the resident rate. Non-residents pay $25 more ($275/week summer, $325 August minicamps, $300 vacation minicamps).
The PLAY price is the 5-day rate. 3-day ($80) and 2-day ($55) options also exist. PLAY is a half day (8:30am-12:30pm).
Summer registration_opens_at is calculated from "2nd Friday in January" (resident) = 2027-01-08. Non-residents open on the 4th Friday = 2027-01-22. It's assumed this also covers the August minicamps.
The six summer weeks are not listed one by one because their dates are TBA. Circle H/Dragonfly sessions stand for one weekly booking each.
Grades are the grade entering in the fall. Registration requires a Camper Contact Form (accepted from Dec 1) and an approved 2027 Summer Camp Membership in Xplor.
5 sessions without full dates were left out

changes: Switched the season from 2027 to 2026: the only 2027 dates are the February and April vacation minicamps, and a summer listing showing only those would mislead. Summer 2027 dates are 'TBA'.

Replaced the two vacation sessions with the six 2026 summer weeks from the town's Summer Camp Themes 2026 PDF (week 1 is 3 days, week 2 is 4 days). Session prices left empty because the page's fees carry no year.
Added the summer camp site, Richmond Middle School, 63 Lyme Road, Hanover 03755, from the Camp Location Maps PDF; this fills the required ZIP.
Added email and refund policy from the Camp Cancellation Policy PDF.
Checked ages, grades, fees ($55 to $325, $250 resident week), activities, Storrs Pond and Mink Brook notes and phone against the Camps page; all match.

refund_policy_summary: Summer camps: full refund if you cancel before March 1; from March 1 on, a refund only if the spot is filled from the waiting list. Minicamps: refund only if the spot is filled from the waiting list. Card refunds lose a 5% processing fee. Camp membership fees are not refundable, and there is no refund if a child is removed for behavior. Requests go in writing to parksandrec@hanovernh.org.
